name: Pilgrim's Return
title: Azrael: Agent of the Bat #59
desc:
Batman has charged Catwoman with a near-impossible task: smuggling a valuable object into the former Gotham City. Azrael's assignment: Make sure she makes it into No Man's Land alive!

Batman charges Azrael to be Catwoman's "guardian angel" as she breaks back into Gotham with stolen discs at Batman's request.

Catwoman's helicopter crashes and she is confronted by the leader of Hardcases, Inc. Azrael stands in to defend her and takes the leader of Hardcases, Inc to Dr. Thompkins for medical treatment.
